Clinic: 4,200 patients, 6 rooms; open 08:00–19:00 weekdays, 09:00–13:00 Saturday. Twelve nurses in three shifts, four admin staff. Accreditation runs to April 2027; renewal needs an infection-control audit. Attendance averages 180/day (peak 310, January 2025 flu wave); no-shows 9%, down from 14% after September 2024 reminder texts.

Key incidents: March 2024 vaccine fridge failure (€2,100 lost) led to a networked alarm plus paper backup log; November 2024 concurrent record edits overwrote an allergy field, so records now lock when open.

Rules: no prescription renewal without a consultation in the past 12 months; vaccine stock counted twice weekly; temperature excursions above 8°C reported same day.

Pending: second ultrasound postponed pending an undone utilisation study; nursing coordinator vacant since August 2025, covered by two senior nurses—unsustainable beyond winter.
